title: Velo Client 1.4.2: Make it yours
summary: Customize every Velo screen with new R-Shift menu styles and the theme editor, a real Velo Browser with TikTok, YouTube and Spotify, any colour for auras and kill effects, fewer lag spikes and lots of fixes.

blocks.text: **Velo Client 1.4.2** is all about making Velo yours: restyle the menus you see every day, browse the web without leaving the game, pick any colour for your effects - and enjoy smoother frames while you do it.

blocks.caption: The new R-Shift menu tab: pick a style and watch the live preview open and close.

items: A new **Customize** page in the launcher for your **title screen, R-Shift menu, pause menu, loading screen, theme** and **launcher**
**Six R-Shift menu styles**: Velo, **Glass** (see-through with a sheen), **Minimal**, **Glow** (a soft halo in your accent), **Neon** and **Solid**
Pick how the menu **opens, closes and switches pages** - slide, fade, zoom, bounce and more - plus speed, see-through, corner roundness and how dark the game gets behind it
The **theme editor** now lives right in Customize, with a live preview
The game picks up every change **right away** - no restart

blocks.caption: Themes: start from a built-in one, change anything, see it live.
The start page: search, or jump straight to your favourite sites.

items: A **real browser** over your game: **YouTube, TikTok, Twitch, Instagram, Spotify** and any other site (replaces the Video Player)
Press **U** to open it - move it, resize it, go fullscreen, search from the start page or type any address
Click away or press Esc and it **keeps playing** in a small window in the corner - or hide it completely and just listen
**Private by design**: no history, no cookies, no logins, no cache are saved - close the game and it's all gone
Downloads once the first time you open it (~120 MB) and uses barely anything while it's closed
**Any colour** for your auras and kill effects - a colour picker next to the swatches, and other Velo players see your colour too
Colour changes show in the game **instantly**
Cosmetics load in the background, so joining a busy server no longer stutters once per player
**Clear Water & Lava**: see further under water and in lava - each on its own
**No Totem Pop**: hide the totem animation, its particles and its sound - each on its own
**Hearts** and **Hunger** now step aside when a server shows its own (MCC Island and others)
**Mini Player** got a **head tilt** setting
The first R-Shift menu of a session no longer hitches - fonts and icons are ready before you open it
Changing a setting or moving the HUD no longer causes a short freeze (that was up to 40 ms every time)
Fewer spikes on Vulkan: the shader cache saves in the background
Velo's HUD costs noticeably less per frame
**"Authentication failed"** when joining a server straight from the launcher
**Windows**: left click no longer keeps spamming after holding it or moving the window
**Windows**: the game only grabs your mouse when its window is really in front
**Windows**: launcher updates no longer need the installer
**Linux**: when the password prompt can't open (Linux Mint and others), the update opens in your package installer instead of failing
Clips on **macOS with VulkanMod** were upside down with wrong colours
26.2 closing when minimized ("out of date swapchain")
26.3 crash with the newest Sodium beta; Color Grading and Motion Blur on 26.3
Color Grading / Motion Blur turning the screen black on 1.21.x
The Launcher Doctor now spots mods that hide your Velo cloak (Cosmetica and others) and offers updating a mod before turning one off
Bigger modpacks get a bit more memory
If the game ever freezes, Velo now notes where - so we can fix it faster
Chain Wings were removed
